usage.source_scope: Single-video recovery of articulated metric door structure and a simulation-ready door twin; robotic policy and demonstration-generation claims are out of scope.
usage.project_application: Retain as a later structural reference only after L10 has independently established a visible exact door. A first future check would compare reconstructed panel, handle, and hinge geometry against held-out metric structure.
usage.modifications: Do not import its wheel-legged robot control, simulation refinement, or success-rate claims. Keep door identity, functional portal, reachability, arrival, and handoff as separate authorities.
usage.expected_effect: Potentially upgrade a confirmed door from a visible portal surface to an articulated structural model. Do not start while the active bottleneck remains visibility or cross-view exact-door transfer.

evaluation.setup: Later reserve; no current experiment planned.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Door-twin reconstruction and robot traversal results do not establish BlindAssist exact-instance acquisition, a usable entrance, phone sensing, user completion, product benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Primary preprint reviewed for single-video articulated door-twin reconstruction and its robot-specific evidence boundary.

history.change: Added as a later door-structure reserve and explicitly held behind visible exact-door qualification.
